cards.front: Recall a key point about Pericles & the Golden Age of Athens
cards.back: Pericles dominated Athenian politics for over 30 years (c. 461-429 BC), elected strategos repeatedly

cards.front: Recall a key point about Pericles & the Golden Age of Athens
cards.back: The Athenian building programme: Parthenon, Propylaea, Erechtheion on the Acropolis, funded by Delian League tribute

cards.front: Recall a key point about Pericles & the Golden Age of Athens
cards.back: Pericles' Funeral Oration (431 BC, recorded by Thucydides) celebrated Athenian democracy, freedom and cultural superiority

cards.front: Recall a key point about Pericles & the Golden Age of Athens
cards.back: The Peloponnesian War (431-404 BC) between Athens and Sparta devastated Greece and ended the Athenian Golden Age

cards.front: Recall a key point about Pericles & the Golden Age of Athens
cards.back: The plague of Athens (430 BC) killed a third of the population, including Pericles himself in 429 BC

cards.front: Recall a key point about Pericles & the Golden Age of Athens
cards.back: Thucydides is our main source: he wrote a contemporary history of the Peloponnesian War, valued for its accuracy and analysis
